main_text.p: nullum produxit Canonem , argumento euidenti, tum illam non fuisse publicatam , sed etiam si ab ipso Photio conficta effet, ne inuidiam aliorum subiret, in tenebras mancipatam delituisse .

Ad haec, si verum est, quod alij tradunt, & firmiter contra Graecos asseuerant, in hac Synodo Photiana nullum esse fermonem introductum de Processione Spiritus ex Filio, sed Photium sua restitutione contentum, ne turbae de nouo excitarentur, & ipse in culpam, & lites impingeret, libentiffime de dogmate prius adeo strenue & voce stentorea proclamatam quaestionem silentio praeterijsse, an non hasce duas postremas Synodi Actiones minimum fictitias, & additicias esse fatebimur? Constantinus Meliteniota Orat. 2. de Processione Spiritus sancti; Ἐ'πάπῃς ἐφ' οἷς ἐκαλεῖτο [?] τῆς Ῥωμαϊκῆς Ἐκκλησίας διαφερόμενον, εἰς τὸν τῆς Κωνσταντίνου μέγιστον [?] θεσμὸν τὸ πρὶν συνη[?]- μης ἐπυχε, ἐν ὑσίεσις ἐξ αὐτῆς ταύτης, καὶ τῇ συν- καταβαίνων ἀρχιερεῦσι [?] θεσπίκως [?] ὁ ἐδοξοδοξῆς κατ- ηζίω), καταλιπὼν τὰ πάντα, καὶ μηδὲ [?] τὴν δόγματος ταύτης ποιησάμενος λόγον πᾶσῃ σπουδῇ, καὶ [?] ἀδεῶν, καὶ τὸ ἐρωτῷ ἐχώρησε. Photius, cum de illis accusaretur a Romana Ecclesia, quae ille antea in Constantinopolitanam maximam

page.notes: The Greek passage is set in a small italic-like fount with uneven ink; many words are doubtful and are marked [?]; the line ends and some accents may be misread. The first line of the Greek quotation is especially uncertain. The Latin text is legible apart from slight ink spread. Printed spellings such as "Processione", "Spiritus", "fatebimur" and "libentiffime" are left as printed. The catchword "fc-" is read from the foot of the page and is partly uncertain.
